```sql
SELECT SUM(ST_Area(l.geometry::geography)) AS total_lake_area
FROM lakes l
WHERE ST_Intersects(l.geometry::geography, 
                    (SELECT r.geometry::geography 
                     FROM regions r 
                     WHERE r.region_name ILIKE '%Grant Township%' 
                       AND r.border_type = 'township'
                       AND ST_Intersects(r.geometry::geography, 
                                         (SELECT r2.geometry::geography 
                                          FROM regions r2 
                                          WHERE r2.region_name ILIKE '%Keweenaw County%' 
                                            AND r2.border_type = 'county'
                                            AND ST_Intersects(r2.geometry::geography, 
                                                              (SELECT r3.geometry::geography 
                                                               FROM regions r3 
                                                               WHERE r3.region_name ILIKE '%Michigan%' 
                                                                 AND r3.border_type = 'state' 
                                                               LIMIT 1)
                                            )
                                          LIMIT 1)
                     )
                     LIMIT 1
                    );
```
